title: [DEV] Profile switch takes long time to sync in AAPSClient
symptom: When enacting a temp profile in AAPSClient, the profile switch takes about 5 minutes to show in AAPSClient, whereas in 3.1.0.3 v1 API it was faster. The sync to NS/AAPS is fast, but the visual update in AAPSClient is delayed.
fix: The issue was addressed by a commit referenced by MilosKozak: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/7cb27fced0a6260bc9486f005b7ab779dade38c8
evidence_quote: this is common behavior. enacting profile may take some time
